chunks: Wherefore We saved him and his entire family
ai.seo_question: Who was saved from the flood along with Noah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the phrase 'and his family' (wa ahlah) is often interpreted to include his wife and son who were excluded, or more commonly, to signify the faithful lineage that survived, contrasting with the disbelievers. This verse underscores the completeness of divine mercy for the righteous, serving as a historical precedent for the preservation of the Ahl al-Bayt and the faithful during times of trial.
